'''Kueller''' was an Almanian army [[General/Legends|general]] who lived hundreds of years before the [[Almanian Uprising]]. He [[Almanian sector invasion|overtook]] [[Almania]] and then the entire [[Mortex sector/Legends|Almanian sector]]. In his later years, he was a beloved leader who was known for his compassion and his decisiveness. However, early on while he was conquering, he was very ruthless and would do anything to consolidate his power.

In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller|Dolph]] took up the name "Kueller", and tried to model himself on the general.
